The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of hydroxylapatite (Ca5(PO4)3OH, COD 1011242). Treat the crystal as infinite and periodic. Around the P atom at fractional (0.0560, 0.4170, 0.7500), how many O atoms lie at the shortest P–O distance (atoms within 0.001 Å of it count as the same distance), and what is that distance? Distances are rounded to 0.001 Å.

A. 2 at 1.496 Å
B. 2 at 4.146 Å
C. 2 at 1.602 Å
D. 1 at 1.496 Å
